event_data.context: Signed cdbc19d upgrades the earlier SQLite UUID table in its migration transaction, backfills timestamp data without rewriting IDs, and replaces the trigger. The test saves a future-dated cursor before upgrading, verifies the same event and cursor, then resumes across new appends and reopen. The full local gate passed 107 tests. All four review threads are resolved; awaiting exact-head App approval and CI.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the testing tools, examples, and parity verification capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
